# RubberOtter

> Open-source ATmega32U4 + HM-10/ESP32 wireless USB HID hardware platform exposing keyboard, mouse, consumer control, and haptic feedback over BLE 5.0 GATT (Service 0xFFE0 / Characteristic 0xFFE1) and USB CDC Serial.

## Highlights

- **Supported Hardware:** SparkFun Pro Micro 5V/16MHz (`pro_micro`, `pro_micro_hid`) and Arduino Leonardo (`leonardo`, `leonardo_hid`) with HM-10 / BT05 BLE module and optional Pin 2 coin vibration motor.
- **Web Serial Flasher:** Browser-based Caterina 1200 bps reset and firmware streaming utility at https://atacanymc.github.io/RubberOtter/.
- **Protocol:** RubberOtter v1 framed `STX/ETX` XOR protocol (`<= 384 B` payload), 6-byte ACK responses, single-byte shortcuts (`0x11`..`0x85`), and `&&`/`;` command chaining.
- **Control PWA:** Moved to the unified standalone control app [RubberDeck](https://atacanymc.github.io/RubberDeck/).
- **Python Ecosystem (`pip install rubberotter`):** Synchronous (`RubberOtter`) and asynchronous (`AsyncRubberOtter`) SDK, CLI (`rubberotter`), stdio MCP server (`rubberotter mcp`), and AI tool registry.
